title: Squid
summary: A huge squid that lives in the Sea of Cortés was accidentally woken up by Dante Vale while searching for the hidden entrace to Hernán Cortés' vault. Feeling threatened and wanting to defend its home, the squid grabbed Dante who kicked it away and invoked Metagolem, instantly scaring the squid away.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
* The squid is referred to as the Huge Squid in its concept art.
* Based on its size, the squid's species appears to be that of a giant squid (Architeuthis dux) or even a colossal squid (Mesonychoteuthis hamiltoni). If it's the latter, Dante would have been incredibly lucky to come across it, as only one colossal squid has ever been filmed in its natural habitat, at a depth of 600m (2000 ft).

A '''huge squid''' that lives in the [[Sea of Cortés]] was accidentally woken up by [[Dante Vale]] while searching for the hidden entrace to [[Hernán Cortés' vault]]. Feeling threatened and wanting to defend its home, the squid grabbed Dante who kicked it away and invoked [[Metagolem]], instantly scaring the squid away. {{source|Gremlow Infestation!}}

== Trivia ==
* The squid is referred to as the ''Huge Squid'' in its concept art.
* Based on its size, the squid's species appears to be that of a giant squid (''Architeuthis dux'') or even a colossal squid (''Mesonychoteuthis hamiltoni''). If it's the latter, Dante would have been incredibly lucky to come across it, as only one colossal squid has ever been filmed in its natural habitat, at a depth of 600m (2000 ft). {{Extsource|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colossal_squid#Filming_in_natural_habitat|Wikipedia}}
